title: Nvidia unveils its Rubin HPC GPU with "more than 50,000" CUDA cores, up from 28,672 in the current Rubin GPU, for agentic workflows and scientific simulations (Jeffrey Kampman/Tom's Hardware)
summary: Jeffrey Kampman / Tom's Hardware: Nvidia unveils its Rubin HPC GPU with “more than 50,000” CUDA cores, up from 28,672 in the current Rubin GPU, for agentic workflows and scientific simulations — Rubin HPC puts “over 50,000” CUDA cores on a chip, implies four-die layout — The Supercomputing 2026 conference is under way …
